modules.description: A public documentation site for your Tiger app — organized, searchable help pages rendered in your active theme.

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; BSD-3-Clause license; release v1.0.0 present; module layout conforms.

description_i18n.es: Un sitio de documentación público para tu aplicación Tiger: páginas de ayuda organizadas y con búsqueda, renderizadas en tu tema activo.
description_i18n.pt: Um site de documentação público para o seu app Tiger — páginas de ajuda organizadas e pesquisáveis, renderizadas no seu tema ativo.
description_i18n.hi: आपके Tiger ऐप के लिए एक सार्वजनिक दस्तावेज़ीकरण साइट — व्यवस्थित, खोजने योग्य सहायता पृष्ठ, आपकी सक्रिय थीम में प्रस्तुत।
description_i18n.de: Eine öffentliche Dokumentations-Website für Ihre Tiger-App — strukturierte, durchsuchbare Hilfeseiten, dargestellt in Ihrem aktiven Theme.
description_i18n.fr: Un site de documentation public pour votre application Tiger — des pages d'aide organisées et consultables, rendues dans votre thème actif.

modules.description: A free, one-page Bootstrap 5 theme for Tiger — self-contained, zero external dependencies, fully editable CSS/JS.

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; MIT license; release v1.0.0 present; module layout conforms.

modules.description: Adds the AWS SDK for PHP so Tiger can store media in Amazon S3 — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Amazon S3 in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the Google Cloud and Azure SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; MIT license; release 3.393.4 present; module layout conforms.

modules.description: Adds the Azure Storage Blob SDK so Tiger can store media in Azure Blob Storage — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Azure Blob Storage in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the AWS and Google Cloud SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: First-party provider module. Vendors microsoft/azure-storage-blob (MIT) as a release-asset bundle; ships no controllers/routes — Bootstrap registers the bundled SDK autoloader, active-only. type:sdk. Mutually exclusive with the AWS / Google Cloud SDK providers via module.json conflict.

modules.description: Adds the Google Cloud Storage SDK so Tiger can store media in Google Cloud Storage — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Google Cloud Storage in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the AWS and Azure SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: First-party provider module. Vendors google/cloud-storage (Apache-2.0) as a release-asset bundle; ships no controllers/routes — Bootstrap registers the bundled SDK autoloader, active-only. type:sdk. Mutually exclusive with the AWS / Azure SDK providers via module.json conflict.

modules.description: A pack of small, dependency-free PHP helper snippets for the Code Area — slug(), human_bytes(), time_ago() and friends. Install it, read the source, and activate the ones you want.

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; BSD-3-Clause license; release v1.0.0 present; module layout conforms.

modules.description: A plugin-layer web application firewall for Tiger — CrowdSec malicious-IP blocking, login/brute-force protection, rate limiting, a request WAF, and captcha challenges, all at the PHP layer with no root or daemon. Built for shared hosting.

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; BSD-3-Clause license; release v1.0.0 present; module layout conforms.

description_i18n.es: Un cortafuegos de aplicaciones web a nivel de plugin para Tiger: bloqueo de IP maliciosas con CrowdSec, protección de inicio de sesión y fuerza bruta, limitación de tasa, un WAF de peticiones y desafíos captcha, todo en la capa PHP sin root ni demonio. Diseñado para alojamiento compartido.
description_i18n.pt: Um firewall de aplicação web em nível de plugin para o Tiger — bloqueio de IPs maliciosos com CrowdSec, proteção de login e força bruta, limitação de taxa, um WAF de requisições e desafios captcha, tudo na camada PHP sem root nem daemon. Feito para hospedagem compartilhada.
description_i18n.hi: Tiger के लिए प्लगइन-स्तर का वेब एप्लिकेशन फ़ायरवॉल — CrowdSec दुर्भावनापूर्ण-IP अवरोधन, लॉगिन/ब्रूट-फ़ोर्स सुरक्षा, दर सीमा, अनुरोध WAF और कैप्चा चुनौतियाँ, सब कुछ PHP परत पर, बिना root या डेमॉन के। साझा होस्टिंग के लिए बनाया गया।
description_i18n.de: Eine Web Application Firewall auf Plugin-Ebene für Tiger — CrowdSec-Sperrung schädlicher IPs, Login- und Brute-Force-Schutz, Rate-Limiting, eine Request-WAF und Captcha-Prüfungen, alles auf PHP-Ebene ohne Root oder Daemon. Für Shared Hosting gebaut.
description_i18n.fr: Un pare-feu applicatif web au niveau des plugins pour Tiger — blocage des IP malveillantes via CrowdSec, protection contre les attaques par force brute, limitation de débit, un WAF de requêtes et des défis captcha, le tout au niveau PHP, sans root ni démon. Conçu pour l'hébergement mutualisé.

modules.description: Free, automatic HTTPS for your Tiger server — Let's Encrypt / ACME certificate issuance + renewal from the admin. Pure-PHP (no certbot/Python), HTTP-01 served natively, auto-renews. For servers you own; stands down where the host manages SSL (cPanel AutoSSL).

review.notes: Public repo; valid manifest + TIGER.md; BSD-3-Clause license; release v1.0.0 present; module layout conforms.

description_i18n.es: HTTPS gratuito y automático para tu servidor Tiger: emisión y renovación de certificados Let's Encrypt / ACME desde el panel. PHP puro (sin certbot ni Python), HTTP-01 servido de forma nativa, renovación automática. Para servidores propios; se desactiva cuando el alojamiento gestiona el SSL (cPanel AutoSSL).
description_i18n.pt: HTTPS gratuito e automático para o seu servidor Tiger — emissão e renovação de certificados Let's Encrypt / ACME pelo admin. PHP puro (sem certbot/Python), HTTP-01 servido nativamente, renovação automática. Para servidores próprios; recua quando a hospedagem gerencia o SSL (cPanel AutoSSL).
description_i18n.hi: आपके Tiger सर्वर के लिए मुफ़्त, स्वचालित HTTPS — एडमिन से Let's Encrypt / ACME प्रमाणपत्र जारी करना और नवीनीकरण। शुद्ध PHP (कोई certbot/Python नहीं), HTTP-01 मूल रूप से सर्व किया जाता है, स्वतः नवीनीकरण। अपने सर्वरों के लिए; जहाँ होस्ट SSL प्रबंधित करता है वहाँ निष्क्रिय रहता है (cPanel AutoSSL)।
description_i18n.de: Kostenloses, automatisches HTTPS für Ihren Tiger-Server — Ausstellung und Erneuerung von Let's-Encrypt-/ACME-Zertifikaten direkt aus der Verwaltung. Reines PHP (kein certbot/Python), HTTP-01 nativ ausgeliefert, erneuert sich automatisch. Für eigene Server; tritt zurück, wo der Hoster das SSL verwaltet (cPanel AutoSSL).
description_i18n.fr: HTTPS gratuit et automatique pour votre serveur Tiger — émission et renouvellement de certificats Let's Encrypt / ACME depuis l'administration. PHP pur (sans certbot ni Python), HTTP-01 servi nativement, renouvellement automatique. Pour vos propres serveurs ; se retire lorsque l'hébergeur gère le SSL (cPanel AutoSSL).
